claim_scope: Simulated. Each variant turns on one fidelity extension of the published model and recomputes the headline MRD numbers. The published configuration is included as the reference, and the published numbers do not change: the extensions are default-off.

stage_i_median_vaf.source: Phallen 2017 (Sci Transl Med 9:eaan2415); Bettegowda 2014 (Sci Transl Med 6:224ra24)

variants.description: The published model: one resistant clone, exponential growth, uniform shedding, a single background floor.
Three resistant clones with different fitness and different shedding, splitting the residual burden unevenly.
Gompertzian growth, calibrated so the initial doubling time is unchanged and growth decelerates towards the carrying capacity.
Each patient relapses at a drawn metastatic site, with that site's own ctDNA shedding multiplier.
The background floor varies across tracked loci, so the mutant read count is over-dispersed relative to a single Poisson.
